financings_after_balance_sheet.what: PIPE private placement of common stock, pre-funded warrants and common warrants (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On October 25, 2023, the Company closed its private investment in public equity (PIPE) offering that resulted in gross proceeds of $92,149,996.41.

warrants.quote: Each Common Warrant has an exercise price per share of $0.7568, became immediately exercisable on the date of issuance and will expire on October 25, 2030.
Each Pre-Funded Warrant has an exercise price of $0.0001 per share of common stock, is immediately exercisable and does not expire.
